name: Urheen
description: Erhu, a Han musical instrument. It began in the Tang Dynasty and has a history of more than a thousand years. It originated from the Xi people in ancient northern my country, who were called Xi Qin at that time. In the past, it was mainly popular in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River, so it was also called Nanhu. Erhu is a unique stringed instrument in my country. It can not only express deep and miserable contents, but also depict magnificent artistic conceptions. Its timbre is close to the human voice and it has high emotional expressiveness.
